cohort: 37 patients diagnosed with tuberculosis-induced intrauterine adhesions (IUA) who underwent hysteroscopic adhesiolysis.
finding: Hysteroscopic adhesiolysis improved uterine cavity conditions and menstrual flow for patients with tuberculosis-induced IUA, but overall reproductive outcomes, including conception and live birth rates, remained suboptimal.
mod_finding: Among those who conceived, 4 delivered at term via cesarean section, with some experiencing postpartum complications.
